format_version.description: The minimum game version required for this block definition.

identifier.description: The unique identifier for this block (e.g., 'fg0:emerald_axe').

minecraft:chest_obstruction.description: [1.26.20+] Determines when the opening of chests placed below the block should be obstructed.

obstruction_rule.description: 'always' prevents chests from opening. 'never' allows them to open. 'shape' checks the block's collision box.

minecraft:collision_box.description: [1.19.50+] Defines the area of the block that entities and particles collide with.

oneOf.description: An array of up to 16 object collision box definitions. An empty array results in full block collision.

minecraft:connection_rule.description: [1.26.0+] Determines whether other blocks such as fences and walls can connect to the block.

accepts_connections_from.description: 'all' allows any block to connect. 'only_fences' restricts connections to fences. 'none' blocks all connections.

enabled_directions.description: Lists the cardinal directions from which other blocks can connect to the block.

minecraft:crafting_table.description: [1.19.50+] Turns your block into a crafting table, opening a functional crafting interface when interacted with.

crafting_tags.description: Determines which recipes can be used by this crafting table. Maximum of 64 tags, up to 64 characters each.

table_name.description: Specifies the language file key or raw string displayed above the crafting grid. Defaults to the block's display name if omitted.

minecraft:destructible_by_explosion.description: [1.19.20+] Determines whether the block can be destroyed by explosions. Can be a boolean or an object with custom resistance.

explosion_resistance.description: Defines how resistant the block is to being destroyed by explosions. Higher values provide greater resistance.

minecraft:destructible_by_mining.description: [1.19.20+] Determines how long it takes for players to mine the block. Can be a boolean or an object setting its hardness.

seconds_to_destroy.description:
Sets the hardness value of the block.

⚠️ WARNING: This parameter name is misleading! It does not set the literal seconds to destroy the block; it sets the base hardness. By default, the actual time it takes to mine a custom block is 1.5× the value set here.

minecraft:destruction_particles.description: [1.21.90+] Determines the appearance of the particles created when hitting, destroying, stepping on, and falling onto blocks.

particle_count.description: Determines how many particles are created when the block is destroyed (0-255).

texture.description: Specifies the texture atlas shortname to use from terrain_texture.json. Defaults to the 'down' material instance.

tint_method.description: Specifies the tint method used to tint the texture based on the biome the block is placed in.

minecraft:display_name.description:
[1.19.60+] The language file key or raw string that determines the text displayed when hovering over the block in the inventory and hotbar.

⚠️ NOTE: Minecraft may revert to using 'tile.<identifier>.name' in some scenarios, such as the 'Can place on' tooltip.

minecraft:embedded_visual.description:
Determines how this block is displayed when inside a Flower Pot. (The block must also have the 'minecraft:flower_pottable' component applied).

🛑 CRITICAL: ROOT ONLY! This component may only be defined in the root components object of your block. It CANNOT be specified per permutation.

geometry.description: The displayed geometry component identifier string or definition object.

material_instances.description: The displayed material instances component object mapping material names to textures/render methods.

minecraft:entity_fall_on.description: [1.21.10+] Causes an entity fall on event to be triggered when an entity falls onto the block.

min_fall_distance.description: The minimum distance (in blocks) that an entity must fall in order to trigger the event.

minecraft:flammable.description: [1.19.10+] Determines how flammable the block is. Can be a boolean or an object defining catching and destruction chances.

catch_chance_modifier.description: Affects the chance that this block catches flame. When 0, fire eventually burns out. When >0, fire burns until destroyed (or forever if destroy_chance is 0). Default is 5 (Vanilla Planks).

destroy_chance_modifier.description: Affects the chance that this block will be consumed/destroyed by flames when on fire. Default is 20 (Vanilla Planks).

minecraft:flower_pottable.description:
Allows the block to be placed in a Flower Pot. Use the 'minecraft:embedded_visual' component to change its appearance inside the pot.

🛑 CRITICAL: ROOT ONLY! This component may only be defined in the root components object of your block. It CANNOT be specified per permutation.

minecraft:friction.description:
[1.19.20+] Determines how slippery the block is for entities moving on top (0.0-0.9). Lower values mean the block is more slippery.

⚠️ WARNING: This component is somewhat broken! While it works correctly on boats, higher friction values cause other entities to speed up rather than slow down.

minecraft:geometry.description:
[1.21.90+] Determines the geometry of this block and any culling rules that should be applied.

⚠️ LIMITATIONS:
1. Model size is limited to 30×30×30 pixels.
2. At least 1 pixel on each axis must sit within the normal 16×16×16 block unit space.
3. The absolute position bounds are 30 pixels in each direction from the origin.

oneOf.description: The identifier of the geometry model (e.g., 'geometry.example_block').

bone_visibility.description: A key-value map determining bone visibility. Keys are exact bone names; values can be booleans or Molang strings.

culling.description: The identifier of the culling rules. Should match format '<namespace>:culling.<name>'.

culling_layer.description: Determines the culling layer identifier. If using 'minecraft', allowed values are 'minecraft:culling_layer.undefined' or 'minecraft:culling_layer.leaves'.

uv_lock.description: Determines whether UV textures lock their original rotation when the block rotates.

minecraft:item_visual.description: [1.21.60+] Determines how this block is displayed as an item when in inventories, item frames, or dropped on the ground.

geometry.description: The displayed geometry component identifier string or definition object.

material_instances.description: The displayed material instances component object mapping material names to textures/render methods.

minecraft:leashable.description: [1.26.0+] Allows leads and balloons to be attached to the block like fences.

offset.description: Determines the position of the middle of the knot relative to the bottom middle of the block.

minecraft:light_dampening.description: [1.19.10+] Determines the maximum number of light levels (0-15) that will be dampened when passing through the block.

minecraft:light_emission.description: [1.19.20+] Determines the integer light level (0-15) emitted by the block.

minecraft:liquid_detection.description: [1.26.0+] Determines how this block behaves with different types of liquid.

detection_rules.description: An array of liquid behavior configurations.

liquid_type.description: Which type of liquid this rule applies to. Currently only 'water' is supported.

can_contain_liquid.description: Whether the liquid type can occupy the same space as this block (e.g., waterlogging).

on_liquid_touches.description: 'blocking' prevents flow. 'broken' breaks the block. 'no_reaction' lets it flow through. 'popped' drops the block as loot.

stops_liquid_flowing_from_direction.description: Directions liquid cannot flow out of (or into, if on_liquid_touches is 'no_reaction').

use_liquid_clipping.description: Determines whether liquid contained in the block is visually clipped based on the block's encompassing collider.

minecraft:loot.description: The path to the loot table file that determines what drops when this block is destroyed. (This is automatically ignored if the block is mined with Silk Touch). If omitted, the block drops itself as an item.

minecraft:map_color.description: Defines the color of the block when it is rendered on an in-game Map. If omitted, the block will be invisible/ignored on maps.

oneOf.description: A hex string format defining the map color (e.g., '#FFFFFF').
An RGB array format defining the map color (e.g., [255, 255, 255]).

color.description: The map color defined as either a hex string or an RGB array.

tint_method.description: Specifies the optional biome-based tint method used to alter the map color dynamically.

minecraft:material_instances.description:
[1.19.40+] Defines the material instances of a block, configuring how parts of the block are rendered.

⚠️ KNOWN ISSUES:
1. Smooth lighting (ambient occlusion) may not perfectly match vanilla blocks (MCPE-237493).
2. In UIs, face dimming applies before item display transforms rotate the model (MCPE-235788).
3. PBR/Raytracing textures are NOT supported when rendered as an entity/item (MCPE-237517).

oneOf.description: The name of another defined material instance to inherit its properties from (e.g., 'end').

texture.description: Specifies the texture atlas shortname to use from terrain_texture.json.

render_method.description: The render method used for faces. Note: All material instances on the block must use the exact same render method.

tint_method.description: Specifies the tint method used to tint the texture based on the biome.

alpha_masked_tint.description: When true, tinting is based on the alpha channel. Requires a valid 'tint_method' and 'render_method' must be 'opaque'.

ambient_occlusion.description: Determines whether smooth lighting is applied. Can be a boolean or a float (0.0-10.0) for intensity.

face_dimming.description: Determines whether faces are dimmed by their direction. Defaults to false for light emitters, true for others.

isotropic.description: Determines whether the UVs of faces are randomly rotated based on the block's world position.

minecraft:movable.description: [1.21.100+] Determines how a block can be moved by pistons.

movement_type.description: 'immovable' prevents movement. 'popped' breaks the block into a loot drop. 'push' allows pushing but not pulling. 'push_pull' allows full piston mechanics.

sticky.description: Setting this to 'same' gives the block slime/honey block functionality, causing adjacent blocks to move with it.

minecraft:placement_filter.description: [1.19.60+] Determines the placement conditions required for a block to be placed or survive. If conditions fail after placement, the block pops off as an item.

conditions.description: List of up to 64 condition objects specifying where the block can exist.

allowed_faces.description: The valid block faces this block can be attached to.

block_filter.description: Array of up to 64 block descriptors that this block can be placed against.

states.description: Specific block state key-value pairs required for matching.

tags.description: A Molang expression string evaluating block tags (e.g., '!q.any_tag(...)').

minecraft:precipitation_interactions.description: [1.21.120+] Determines how the block interacts with precipitation (rain and snow).

precipitation_behavior.description: 'obstruct_rain_accumulate_snow' blocks rain and allows snow layers to build up on top. 'obstruct_rain' blocks rain but prevents snow accumulation. 'none' allows both rain and snow to pass right through the block.

minecraft:random_offset.description: [1.21.100+] Causes a random offset to be applied to the block based on its world position, shifting its collision, selection, and geometry. Offset models must still adhere to geometry limits.

minecraft:redstone_conductivity.description: [1.21.40+] Defines the block's ability to conduct redstone power and interact with redstone wire routing.

redstone_conductor.description: Determines whether this block conducts direct redstone power (like stone or dirt blocks vs. glass or slabs).

allows_wire_to_step_down.description: Determines whether redstone wire can travel down the side of this block if it is a non-conductor. (Redstone wire can always travel down the side of true redstone conductors).

minecraft:redstone_consumer.description:
Allows the block to respond to redstone power via custom components using the onRedstoneUpdate() event hook.

🛑 CRITICAL: ROOT ONLY! This component may only be defined in the root components object of your block. It CANNOT be specified per permutation.

min_power.description: Determines the minimum power level required to trigger the onRedstoneUpdate() custom component event hook.

propagates_power.description: Determines whether this block conducts redstone power to adjacent blocks. Note: This overrides 'redstone_conductor' in the redstone conductivity component, allowing a block to act like a conductor for routing while not actually passing power.

minecraft:redstone_producer.description: Causes the block to produce and emit redstone power.

power.description: Determines the power level produced by the block as an integer (0-15).

strongly_powered_face.description: Determines the direction where strong power is produced. If strong power is received by a redstone conductor, blocks surrounding that conductor will also become powered.

connected_faces.description: Determines which directions power is produced in. By default, all faces are connected.

transform_relative.description: Determines whether face directions should dynamically rotate based on the rotation values defined in the block's transformation component.

minecraft:replaceable.description: Allows this block to be automatically replaced when a player attempts to place another block in its exact position (similar to grass, tall grass, or snow layers). Note: It does not allow the block to be replaced by a block of the exact same permutation.

minecraft:selection_box.description: [1.19.60+] Defines the area of the block that can be selected/targeted by players. When true, a standard full-block outline is used. When false, the block cannot be targeted at all.

origin.description: The bottom north-western corner of the selection box, measured in pixels from the bottom center of the block unit. Range: [-8, 0, -8] to [8, 16, 8].

size.description: The size of each side of the selection box in pixels, extending from the origin point.

minecraft:support.description: [1.26.0+] Defines the block's ability to support other blocks that are attached to it (like torches or carpets resting properly on non-standard shapes).

shape.description: Configures the block's top/side attachment behavior to mimic a vanilla fence or stair shape.

minecraft:tick.description:
[1.21.10+] Causes the block to 'tick' after a random delay within the interval_range. Handled via the onTick() custom component event hook.

⚠️ NOTE: Chunks have a hard limit of 100 queued block ticks per game tick. If a chunk contains a massive amount of ticking blocks, execution might be slightly delayed.

interval_range.description: Two integers [min, max] defining the minimum and maximum delay (in game ticks) before the block ticks.

looping.description: Determines whether the block should continuously schedule a new tick after one finishes, or only tick once.

minecraft:transformation.description: [1.21.0+] Determines the transformation (translation, rotation, and scaling) of the block's geometry, collision box, and selection box. Transformed models must still adhere to geometry limits.

translation.description: The number of block units to offset the geometry by on each axis [X, Y, Z].

rotation.description: The number of degrees to rotate the geometry by on each axis [X, Y, Z]. Must be in increments of 90 (use negative numbers for counter-clockwise rotation).

rotation_pivot.description: The pivot point (in block units) to rotate the block on. Defaults to the center of the block [0, 0, 0].

scale.description: The multiplier factor to scale the geometry by on each axis [X, Y, Z].

scale_pivot.description: The pivot point (in block units) to scale the block from. Defaults to the center of the block [0, 0, 0].

origin.description: Bottom north-western corner of the collision box. Measured in pixels from the bottom center of the block unit. [-8, 0, -8] to [8, 16, 8].

size.description: Size of each side of the collision box. Sum of origin and size must be in the range [-8, 0, -8] to [8, 24, 8].

steps.description: Determines how many equally-spaced random values can be chosen across the range. A value of 0 means any continuous float value within the range can be picked.

min.description: The minimum offset distance on this axis.

max.description: The maximum offset distance on this axis.
